messages:
Samira (CS): Quick day-3 sync for Pegasus private deploy. Ran ingress smoke this morning — intermittent TLS failures when egressing 10.23.5.0/24 -> S3. Customer flagged latency spikes and said renewal conversations will hinge on predictable latency. Tagging infra + security. OnboardBot created ticket CS-7894.

Alex W: Looking at ELB logs, 502s around 03:14 UTC, connection reset. Suspect MTU/fragmentation on their site-to-site VPN. Can we get their tunnel MTU and a quick pcap from their bastion? I can run traceroute and tcpdump.

Priya S: Noted. Also KMS note: they asked for daily key rotation window 02:00-03:00 UTC but backups run 02:30. That will cause decrypt spikes. Options: move rotation to 03:30, or change to weekly rotation + tighter audit alerts. Need to forward kms:Decrypt audit events to their audit bucket (and ours) too.

Jordan M: Re: TLS spike, ask customer to run this from their bastion and paste output here during a maintenance window:
```
curl -v --resolve pegasus.internal:443:10.23.5.12 https://pegasus.internal/health 
```
This will show TLS handshake timing + any early connection resets.

Samira (CS): Action items: 1) @Alex W — confirm MTU and share pcap summary; 2) @Priya S — propose KMS policy + audit-forward plan; 3) @Jordan M — provide test command and short runbook clip for customer to run. Capture customer feedback about renewals (they mentioned SLA credits if variance >5%). I'll update CS risk board.

Alex W: Ran a 20s capture from our side and correlated with their ELB timestamps — signs of PMTU blackhole when packets are >1400 bytes. Quick remediation on their edge: enable MSS clamping or set tunnel MTU to 1400. I'll message their net team and attach the capture snippet to CS-7894.

Priya S: Draft KMS policy snippet for proposed cross-account decrypt logging (please review):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pegasus-audit"},
    "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"
  }]
}
```
Will add retention/export steps to ticket.

Jordan M: I'll draft a 2-step runbook (test + what-to-change) and add a short GIF for the console path to enable audit forwarding. ETA EOD.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-7894 updated — assignees: Alex W, Priya S, Jordan M. Status: investigation. Next update expected within 8 hours.

Samira (CS): Thanks — risk note: if we don't stabilize within 48h, escalate to AM for renewal mitigation conversation and consider a temporary SLA amendment. @Priya S please add to renewal_risk tracker and flag legal if we need wording. :warning:

Priya S: Added to renewal_risk board and created a doc stub for SLO amendment language. Will sync with legal if metrics show >5% latency variance.

Samira (CS): Also capturing customer feedback: they appreciate that we’re responsive but asked for a clearer pre-cutover network checklist and a short KMS rotation FAQ. @Jordan M can we bundle these into the onboarding repo?

Jordan M: Yes — will add a "network pre-cutover checklist" and a short KMS Q&A to the onboarding repo and reference it in CS-7894. Will ping when PR is ready.

Samira (CS): Great. Closing loop for now — please post quick follow-ups to the ticket rather than long Slack threads so the customer-facing timeline is clean.
